title.narrative: Reporting Diversity Network 2.0

description.narrative: The project will empower a regional network of CSOs to work together with the aim to influence the quality of media messages affecting perceptions of ethnicity, religion and gender as pressing thematic areas relevant for overall levels of understanding and tolerance in the Western Balkans. The Reporting Diversity Network (RDN) will provide tools, resources and much needed evidence for the entire civil society to promote more inclusive media, and effective policy-making advancing tolerance.

comment.narrative: Following Outcome level indicators are fully met and surpassed RDN 2.0 network expanded to 13 CSO members Monitoring and reacting to media reporting on diversity becomes regular practice in the work of at least 40 CSOs RDN 2.0 produced at least 36 monthly and 1 joint regional monitoring reports targeting media and policymakersThe status of indicators is Regional reporting diversity network of 16 members created and operational 49 CSOs incapacitated in reacting to media misconduct RDN 2.0 produced 36 monthly 12 national and 2 joint regional monitoring reports targeting media and policymakersHowever the evaluation report concluded Overall it can be concluded that the envisaged Outcome To create a robust network of CSOs capacitated to effectively influence media reporting which shapes perceptions of ethnicity religion and gender in the Western Balkans was partially achieved as it will be demonstrated further in the report. The conclusion takes into consideration the said weakness of the ToC and complexity of the Projects Outcome. Creating a Network robust enough to influence the media reporting is a challenging task one that cannot be achieved over a period of four years given the increasing hostile context RDN operates in. The envisaged outcome is additionally challenging as it envisages RDN influencing media practice across WB and shaping perceptions of ethnicity religion and gender by effectively. This task is complex and demanding it requires adequate methodology and tools for measuring the said effectiveness something RDN is yet to develop.However the report also concluded among other RDN 2.0 has clearly demonstrated the need for its existence and has laid a solid path for further empowerment of CSOs members or nonmembers to challenge divisive narratives by promoting diversity raising awareness among youth and other citizens and in the long term influence media and other stakeholders.For more details please see Project final evaluation report.
